# @vllnt/logger

> Zero-dependency structured JSON logger for TypeScript with scoped events, log levels, timing, and console, PostHog and test outputs for Node.js and Convex.

Scoped events (`auth.login`), levels `debug`, `info`, `warn`, `error`, and pluggable synchronous outputs. Log calls never throw. The Node.js preset `createBackendLogger` reads `LOG_LEVEL` from `process.env` on each call and defaults to `warn`. There is no built-in redaction. ESM only; TypeScript `moduleResolution` must be `nodenext`, `node16` or `bundler`.

## For coding agents

The docs are bundled in the package at `node_modules/@vllnt/logger/docs/`, with the TypeScript sources in `node_modules/@vllnt/logger/src/`. They match the installed version. Read them before writing code.

## When to use

- Use it when you want one JSON line per event, with a scoped event name, from TypeScript.
- Use it when the same logger API must run in Node.js and in Convex queries, mutations and actions.
- Use it when log entries should go to several outputs, such as the console and PostHog.
- Use it when tests should assert on log entries instead of console output.
- Do not use it when you need log transports, files, rotation, redaction or async batching: use pino or winston.
- Do not use it when entries must be stored and queried later: use [`@vllnt/convex-events`](https://oss.vllnt.com/packages/convex-events).
- Do not use it for product analytics with consent: use [`@vllnt/analytics`](https://oss.vllnt.com/packages/analytics).

## Docs

- [API Reference](./docs/API.md): Every public export, its signature and an example, per entry point
- [Errors and fixes](./README.md#errors-and-fixes): Every error message and marker, its cause and the fix
- [Limits and gotchas](./README.md#limits-and-gotchas): Defaults and calls that silently do nothing
- [README](./README.md): Install, quick start, API table, common tasks and compatibility
- [Changelog](./CHANGELOG.md): Version history and release notes

## Entry points

- `@vllnt/logger`: core API and Node.js preset (`createBackendLogger`)
- `@vllnt/logger/convex`: `createConvexLogger`, no `process.env` access
- `@vllnt/logger/posthog`: `createPostHogOutput`
- `@vllnt/logger/testing`: `createTestOutput`
